title: Perfect route and very knowledgeable
text: Great route through the city of Barcelona with a very knowledgeable guide and you can see that he enjoys. Nothing heavy was done to us, on the contrary we stayed more than 2h and would have continued without problem. Quite a hit
author: C3267EXsilviaf

title: Amazing Knights Templar Tour
text:
My favorite tour in Barcelona was definitely the Knights TemplarTour. Our tour guide Eduardo was very knowledgeable about the history of the Templars and the City in  General. We learned a lot. He was a very friendly guide. I highly recommend this tour. You will not regret it!
Olivia Welch
author: Extraordinary632536
